content.h1: Find the Best Free PDF Scanner App for iPhone and iPad
content.quick_answer: The best free PDF scanner apps for iPhone and iPad let you digitize multi-page documents without subscriptions, watermarks, or page limits. Look for features like automatic edge detection, enhancement filters, and the ability to combine multiple scans into one PDF. Verify that all core scanning and export functions are free and run on your device for privacy.
intro: If you need to scan a stack of printed papers into a clear PDF on your iPhone or iPad, finding a truly free app can be a challenge. Many apps offer basic scanning, but then hide essential features behind subscriptions or add watermarks to your documents.

This page helps you identify genuinely free PDF scanner options for iOS. We will cover what to look for in a free app, compare it to built-in iOS tools, and show how Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit provides comprehensive free scanning features without hidden costs or watermarks.
content.steps_heading: How to Choose a Free PDF Scanner App for iOS

steps.title: Test Multi-Page Scanning
steps.detail: Download a few free scanner apps and try scanning a document with 3-4 pages. Check if the app lets you capture all pages in one session and combine them into a single multi-page PDF. Ensure the app performs automatic edge detection and crops the pages without manual adjustments for each photo.

steps.title: Evaluate Enhancement Features
steps.detail: After scanning, check for one-tap enhancement filters like Black & White or Colour Boost. Look for a shadow removal feature that evens out lighting, which is useful for scans taken in poor light. A good free app should offer basic image correction to make your scans clear and readable.

steps.title: Look for Watermarks and Limits
steps.detail: Review your exported PDF. Verify there are no watermarks placed on the document and no caps on the number of pages you can scan or the number of documents you can save per day. Many "free" apps impose these restrictions, making them unsuitable for regular use without a paid upgrade.

steps.title: Check Export and Sharing Options
steps.detail: Confirm you can save the scanned PDF to your device or share it directly to common cloud services like iCloud Drive, Google Drive, or Dropbox. The ability to easily export your documents is crucial for integrating your scans into your workflow.

content.alternatives_heading: Other Ways to Scan Documents on iOS

alternatives.how: Open or create a note, tap the camera button, choose Scan Documents. The scan is saved inside the note and can be shared as a PDF.
alternatives.best_for: Quick, single-page scans for personal notes or casual use.
alternatives.limitation: The Notes app applies automatic contrast but has no dedicated shadow-removal control. Page order cannot be rearranged after scanning if you combine multiple images.

alternatives.how: Open Files, tap the More (   ) button, and choose Scan Documents. The result is saved as a PDF in that location.
alternatives.best_for: Scanning directly into a specific folder on your device or cloud storage.
alternatives.limitation: Like Notes, the Files scanner lacks specific shadow removal. You can select several images or PDFs and choose Create PDF, but page order follows the selection and cannot be rearranged there.

alternatives.how: Upload your document to a website that offers PDF scanning or conversion services.
alternatives.best_for: Occasional, non-sensitive documents if you do not want to install an app.
alternatives.limitation: These tools require uploading the document to a third-party server, which is a privacy concern for IDs, contracts, or financial records. Free tiers often limit file size or daily use.

content.tips_heading: Tips for Getting the Best Free Scans on iOS
tips: Place your document on a flat, contrasting surface for better edge detection.
Ensure good, even lighting to minimize shadows on your document.
Use the app's enhancement filters, especially Shadow Removal, to improve readability of scans taken in less ideal conditions.
Review your scans before saving to ensure all text is clear and no important details are cut off.
When scanning multiple pages, keep them in order as you capture them to simplify reordering later.
